_comment: Rename to config.json to activate (vendored mode only — the referenced action takes these as inputs instead). `preview` builds & serves the pushed code in CI so screenshots match the commit exactly (no deployed URL needed); omit it to screenshot the deployed homepage. `routes` hints Gemini toward real pages worth screenshotting. `includeCommitLink` appends the commit URL to the post (default false).

preview.command: npm ci && npm run build && npx serve -l 4173 dist
